profile_csv_structure.title: Profile CSV structure with an explicit dialect
profile_csv_structure.purpose: Inspect an in-memory CSV extract before downstream transformation; report row-width distribution, baseline-column completeness, exact header issues and physical lines without opening a task file.

sourcebasis.purpose: Existing bounded JSON/typed-record and prior-supply reference; not a claim this source implements the new method.

profile_csv_structure.reuse_and_distinctness: Extends prior filesystem CSV audit with explicit quote dialect, full width histogram and per-column completeness. Overlap is disclosed; this is not claimed as a wholly new CSV-audit family.

limits.method: At most1000 CSV records including header,64 fields per record,4096 Unicode characters per field and131072 characters in the CSV string. Delimiter and quote character are explicit. Columns describe baseline width only; wider rows stay visible in width reports. Headers compare exactly; only the empty string is blank. When header=true, a CSV record must exist and its parsed field list must contain at least one field; empty CSV and an empty first parsed record([]) refuse. A one-field header with an empty name is allowed and reported as blank.

methodinterface.transport: UTF-8 JSON stdin -> UTF-8 JSON stdout
